description: Manifest-level OpenHands source identity and exact file mapping for every adopted mechanics source file.
rule: Disk <-> provenance exact 1:1 path equality at the production mechanics root; every vendored file and local import belongs to the mechanics root.tsx dependency closure; every adopted source-scope entry has a vendored provenance entry.

entry_shape.upstream_path: src/... (path within OpenHands repo at the frozen ref; must equal an approved source-scope entry and satisfy source-policy constraints)
entry_shape.local_path: apps/workspace/src/mechanics/... (path in Xingwen production mechanics; must resolve inside that root, no traversal)
entry_shape.modified: boolean; false requires KEEP_AS_IS, true requires a patched adoption class and modification_reason
entry_shape.modification_reason: null when modified=false; non-empty string when modified=true

source_of_truth: GitHub official repository + Tag v1.10.0 + 40-char SHA + upstream lock/source policy. Not any local clone.
